name: SNIPR WebMCP
description: Sanitized example of the WebMCP-style tools used by the private SNIPR implementation.

tools.name: snipr_get_assignment_context
tools.description: Returns scoped assignment, address, room, and resident-choice context for an authorized user.

tools.name: snipr_search_catalog
tools.description: Searches product/catalog information relevant to a room or element.

tools.name: snipr_get_planning
tools.description: Returns planning status and available inspection slots for an assignment.

tools.name: snipr_propose_planning_action
tools.description: Prepares a planning action, then requires explicit human approval before writing back to SNIPR.

safety.write_policy: Human approval required before operational changes
